reason: With eight confirmation units, a two-sided sign-flip test has only 256 sign patterns. Its minimum attainable exact p-value cannot survive the originally declared 45-test Holm family. No empirical case result was produced before this amendment.

state_design_replacement.source: existing frozen 32-state input bank for each case
state_design_replacement.reset_rule: restore the same pretrained checkpoint, declared carrier value, and zero AdamW moments before every state
state_design_replacement.claim_boundary: units are independently sampled frozen inputs conditional on one checkpoint and cold-start AdamW; they are not independent checkpoints or training runs

multiplicity_replacement.primary_family: five cases times three predeclared effect branches at the ADAMW_UPDATE endpoint
multiplicity_replacement.explanation_family: five cases times LOCAL and PARAMETER_GRADIENT times three predeclared effect branches
multiplicity_replacement.method: Holm family-wise adjustment separately within the primary and explanation families
multiplicity_replacement.headline_boundary: only ADAMW_UPDATE belongs to the primary training-equivalence result; LOCAL and PARAMETER_GRADIENT locate where an effect appears or disappears

optimizer_boundary: This amendment measures cold-start AdamW from zero moments at each state. It does not claim behavior under warm moments.
